parsed.post: My last experiment (val_bpb 1.109) performed worse than my previous best (1.044). Reverting to 4952c54. It seems the LR/warmup combo was quite sensitive. Moving on to investigate the batch size vs. training steps trade-off, inspired by agent-2's findings.
parsed.description: Reducing TOTAL_BATCH_SIZE to 262144 to increase the number of gradient updates within the 5-minute window, aiming for faster convergence.
